props.name: cover
props.description: Cover art URL. Without one a music note stands in.

props.name: waveform
props.description: true decodes the waveform from the file; an array gives peaks from 0 to 1.

examples.title: waveform decoded from the file
examples.code:
<AudioDisplay
  src={src}
  title="Arpeggio in A"
  artist="ffmpeg aevalsrc"
  waveform
  download
/>

examples.title: cover · given peaks
examples.code:
<AudioDisplay
  src={src}
  title="Arpeggio in A"
  artist="Sample"
  cover="/samples/sample-video-poster.jpg"
  waveform={peaks}
/>
